title: UOB’s published SORA package, with the conditions in view.
summary: An existing public schedule for completed homes. This first record establishes a baseline; it does not identify a newly launched promotion.

sections.heading: Read before enquiring
sections.text: The published schedule has a two-year lock-in and a S$250,000 minimum loan. No current SORA fixing is included here, so these spreads are not all-in mortgage rates.

sections.heading: Availability and benefits
sections.text: UOB describes a limited tranche. One conversion after 24 months from first disbursement is subject to the Letter of Offer. Prepayment and sale concessions have separate conditions; confirm those and all charges with UOB.

package.eligibility: New direct-to-bank customers; completed Singapore residential property, purchase or refinancing from another bank/HDB.
package.conditions: Indicative terms; the Letter of Offer confirms rates and benefits. Subject to change without notice.
